source.text: 6.2 Where a single Purchase Order covers twenty-five (25) or more units, the aggregate price for the units in that order shall reflect a volume discount of 3.5%.
7.2 The Buyer shall settle each properly issued invoice within fourteen (14) days from the date appearing on that invoice.
